PC: Perform initial evaluation and interventions for undifferentiated altered mental status
Obtain a focused history from caregiver/emergency medical service (EMS)
Manage ventricular tachycardia with a pulse and poor perfusion
Manage severe hyperthermia in setting of possible anticholinergic toxicity
Post-intubation chest x-ray (CXR) for placement confirmation
MK: Recognize history and exam findings concerning for anticholinergic toxicity
Recognize vital sign abnormalities - Tachycardia, hypertension, hyperthermia/fever
Verbalize differential diagnosis for altered mental status
SBP: Signout to pediatric intensive care unit (PICU)
